about_the_game:
You lost everything. Now it’s time to take it all back.
In Stolen Legacy: Rise of The Fallen, you start from the bottom after your empire collapses. Your wealth, your name, your influence — all stripped away. Now, it’s time to hustle your way back up.

Complete missions, make smart investments, and get your hands dirty as you rebuild what was once yours. Every move brings you one step closer to restoring your legacy.

💼 Idle Crime Simulation
Click your way through jobs, missions, and criminal deals as your empire grows  even when you're offline.

📈 Live Stock Market
Buy and sell stocks in real-time. Watch the numbers and invest smart to build long-term wealth.

🏦 Bank Interest System
Deposit earnings to grow your money passively  or spend it fast to climb faster.

🎲 Casino Mini-Games
Play blackjack or spin the Lucky Wheel with in-game currency. Take the risk, reap the reward.

🏙️ Business Investments
Buy businesses that generate passive income. The bigger the investment, the bigger the payout.

📊 Character Progression
Upgrade your stats and skills to earn more, click faster, and unlock deeper systems.

🗂️ Missions & Jobs
Do the dirty work. Run street missions, climb the ladder, and unlock higher-paying gigs.

🎯 From Nothing to Everything

Start with nothing no money, no power, no respect. Build it all back, one move at a time, and rise to claim everything they said you’d never have again.
